verdict.rationale: Abacum's own docs say its AI runs inside the financial model, so answers are grounded in the model rather than generated freely. Separately, it claims statements are built off live ERP actuals that are traceable, with drill-down to source data. However, nothing shows an external agent can query the engine (OpenAPI probes return 404), and nothing explicitly ties lineage to the AI's answers on runway, forecast or variance. Missing for 10: a documented agent or API access path to the calculation engine, explicit per-answer lineage on AI responses, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can ask the model a finance question (runway, forecast, variance) and the figures come from the platform's calculation engine with lineage, not from a language model's guess

citations.quote: Abacum runs AI inside your model, so every answer is consistent, reusable, and grounded in how your business actually works.
so the numbers are current when someone asks and traceable when they question them
Real-time consolidation of the three statements with drill-down to source data.
